description: Use when you need an llm chat completion for summaries, extraction or classification from a cheap open model. Do not use for frontier models, tool calling or streaming. Returns JSON with a chat completion from IBM Granite 4.0 Micro on Workers AI, with token usage for 0.002 USDC per thousand tokens, up to 0.03 USDC per call (clients without upto pay the cap). Result in the same call (about 8000 ms); a status tool polls for free if it takes longer. Category: Inference.

maxTokens.description: Maximum tokens to generate (1-4096, 512 when omitted); billed as requested

messages.description: Conversation so far, oldest first, e.g. [{"role": "user", "content": "Summarize: ..."}]

response_format.description: concise (the default when omitted) keeps the JSON short: long fields such as base64 images or audio come back as separate image/audio content blocks and other long strings are cut with a marker; detailed returns the full JSON

temperature.description: Sampling temperature (0-2), e.g. 0.2 for near-deterministic output

name: blackwood_llm_chat

next.description: Suggested next paid call in the same family (call it in a loop when the task continues)

sample.description: Free fixed sample of the whole family

service.description: Service id of the suggested next paid call

tool.description: MCP tool name of the same call

url.description: Paid route of the next call

useWhen.description: When the next call is the right one

anyOf.description: x402 PaymentRequired (returned with isError when payment is needed)

title: LLM chat completion
